title: 银行流水与凭证对账
learningObjective: 能在统一期间汇总双方金额，识别单侧缺失及金额差异。
concept: 银行原始支出为负，净支出取负号后求和；退款冲回减少净支出。每真实参考号一行，无参考号银行行按独立编号保留。差额=银行净支出−账簿费用。
syntax:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT 0 unreferenced, reference_no ref, SUM(expense_cents) ledger
  FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no
), b AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,
    COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref, SUM(-amount_cents) bank
  FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))
), k AS (
  SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM a UNION SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM b
)
SELECT CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN CONCAT('BANK-',k.ref) ELSE k.ref END ref,
  a.ledger ledger_cents,b.bank bank_cents,COALESCE(b.bank,0)-COALESCE(a.ledger,0) difference_cents,
  CASE WHEN a.ref IS NULL THEN 'bank_only' WHEN b.ref IS NULL THEN 'ledger_only' ELSE 'difference' END issue,
  CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN 'unreferenced_bank' ELSE 'reference' END reference_kind
FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON a.ref=k.ref AND a.unreferenced=k.unreferenced
LEFT JOIN b ON b.ref=k.ref AND b.unreferenced=k.unreferenced
WHERE a.ref IS NULL OR b.ref IS NULL OR a.ledger<>b.bank ORDER BY ref,reference_kind

parameters.金额: 整数马币分；比率按题设

useCase: 财务人员核对2025年费用凭证与银行交易。先匹配参考号再回查单据，不以金额相等代替匹配。

commonError.example: 逐笔取绝对值并只做内连接。
commonError.correction: 按带符号金额汇总，使用全量键及缺失类型。

notes: 完整输出见 ../enterprise_reference/business_tasks/results/BP19.json；公开预览展示前12行。独立边界及场景仅在提交判题时使用。

steps.label: 按真实参考号分别汇总有符号金额
给无参考号流水独立类型及编号键

teaching.problem: 财务人员核对2025年费用凭证与银行交易。先匹配参考号再回查单据，不以金额相等代替匹配。
teaching.codeExplanation: a 按真实凭证号汇总，b 按参考号及缺失类型汇总。k 用 UNION 保留双方全部键；两个 LEFT JOIN 保留单侧记录。缺失侧金额保持空值，仅计算差额时补零。合成显示名不是连接键，类型标识参与连接，避免真实 BANK-4 与银行编号4碰撞。
teaching.resultExplanation: A 的1000支出及100退款合为900，与账簿一致；B 仅账簿500，C 银行600与账簿700差−100；D 仅银行300。两个无编号银行行各自保留。真实 BANK-4 已匹配，合成 BANK-4 仍独立。

mergeExamples.label: 凭证净额
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_expenses(reference_no,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (VALUES ('A','2025-01-01',1000),('A','2025-01-02',-100),('B','2025-02-01',500),('C','2025-03-01',700),('BANK-4','2025-01-01',200)),
bank_transactions(bank_id,reference_no,transaction_date,amount_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'A','2025-01-01',-1000),(2,'A','2025-01-02',100),(3,'C','2025-03-01',-600),(4,NULL,'2025-01-01',-80),(5,'D','2025-02-01',-300),(6,'BANK-4','2025-01-01',-200),(7,NULL,'2025-02-01',-20)),
a AS (SELECT 0 unreferenced,reference_no ref,SUM(expense_cents) ledger FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no) SELECT ref,ledger FROM a ORDER BY ref

mergeExamples.label: 银行净支出
mergeExamples.explanation: 退款为正流水，转为负支出；空号独立分组。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_expenses(reference_no,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (VALUES ('A','2025-01-01',1000),('A','2025-01-02',-100),('B','2025-02-01',500),('C','2025-03-01',700),('BANK-4','2025-01-01',200)),
bank_transactions(bank_id,reference_no,transaction_date,amount_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'A','2025-01-01',-1000),(2,'A','2025-01-02',100),(3,'C','2025-03-01',-600),(4,NULL,'2025-01-01',-80),(5,'D','2025-02-01',-300),(6,'BANK-4','2025-01-01',-200),(7,NULL,'2025-02-01',-20)),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref,SUM(-amount_cents) bank FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))) SELECT unreferenced,ref,bank FROM b ORDER BY 1,2

mergeExamples.label: 完整对账
mergeExamples.explanation: 保留单侧及金额不符，已匹配的记录不输出。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_expenses(reference_no,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (VALUES ('A','2025-01-01',1000),('A','2025-01-02',-100),('B','2025-02-01',500),('C','2025-03-01',700),('BANK-4','2025-01-01',200)),
bank_transactions(bank_id,reference_no,transaction_date,amount_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'A','2025-01-01',-1000),(2,'A','2025-01-02',100),(3,'C','2025-03-01',-600),(4,NULL,'2025-01-01',-80),(5,'D','2025-02-01',-300),(6,'BANK-4','2025-01-01',-200),(7,NULL,'2025-02-01',-20)),
a AS (SELECT 0 unreferenced,reference_no ref,SUM(expense_cents) ledger FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref,SUM(-amount_cents) bank FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))),
k AS (SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM a UNION SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM b)
SELECT CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN 'BANK-'||k.ref ELSE k.ref END ref,a.ledger ledger_cents,b.bank bank_cents,COALESCE(b.bank,0)-COALESCE(a.ledger,0) difference_cents,CASE WHEN a.ref IS NULL THEN 'bank_only' WHEN b.ref IS NULL THEN 'ledger_only' ELSE 'difference' END issue,CASE WHEN k.unreferenced=1 THEN 'unreferenced_bank' ELSE 'reference' END reference_kind FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON a.ref=k.ref AND a.unreferenced=k.unreferenced LEFT JOIN b ON b.ref=k.ref AND b.unreferenced=k.unreferenced WHERE a.ref IS NULL OR b.ref IS NULL OR a.ledger<>b.bank ORDER BY ref,reference_kind

mergeExamples.explanation: 真实 BANK-4 和合成 BANK-4 不得合并。
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH v_expenses(reference_no,entry_date,expense_cents) AS (VALUES ('A','2025-01-01',1000),('A','2025-01-02',-100),('B','2025-02-01',500),('C','2025-03-01',700),('BANK-4','2025-01-01',200)),
bank_transactions(bank_id,reference_no,transaction_date,amount_cents) AS (VALUES (1,'A','2025-01-01',-1000),(2,'A','2025-01-02',100),(3,'C','2025-03-01',-600),(4,NULL,'2025-01-01',-80),(5,'D','2025-02-01',-300),(6,'BANK-4','2025-01-01',-200),(7,NULL,'2025-02-01',-20)),
a AS (SELECT 0 unreferenced,reference_no ref,SUM(expense_cents) ledger FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY reference_no),
b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END unreferenced,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR)) ref,SUM(-amount_cents) bank FROM bank_transactions WHERE transaction_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN reference_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,COALESCE(reference_no,CAST(bank_id AS CHAR))),
k AS (SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM a UNION SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM b) SELECT unreferenced,ref FROM k WHERE ref IN ('BANK-4','4') ORDER BY 1
